profile_text.body:
Digital Realty Trust, Inc., also known as Digital Realty, provides data center services and colocation. Its website describes the company as delivering what it calls the world's largest data center platform, with data centers, connectivity, and cloud services across a global ecosystem. It says the platform supports deployments from single racks to private suites and high-density AI workflows, and describes itself as sustainably built for flexibility, open ecosystems, and reach.

The company's site highlights AI infrastructure as a current focus. It states that inference loads and GPU demands are pushing traditional environments to their limits, and that AI is exposing infrastructure gaps. A 2026 Global Data Insights Survey promoted on the site reports that 40% of IT leaders cite infrastructure as an AI constraint.

Public records identify Digital Realty Trust, Inc. as a for-profit public company headquartered in Austin, Texas, trading under the ticker DLR, with SEC CIK number 0001297996. Texas court records list 126 matters naming the company.
